direction: About 10 seconds. Slow overhead push onto the plane table. The surveyor's hand inks a fine boundary line around field shapes in pencil, with the house drawn as a small block. No writing is legible. Ambience: the pen scratching and the first drops of rain on paper.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 overhead close-up, c. 1790. A hand in a dark wool cuff holds a quill and inks fine boundary lines over pencil field outlines on cream laid paper pinned to a wooden plane table. A small rectangle marks a farmhouse, and a brass alidade, an inkwell and a few raindrops sit on the paper. Period-accurate surveying, no legible text, no heraldry, no crest or cartouche emblem.
